test_title: PYST 20: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 13 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the triad that follows the same pattern as that followed by the two triads given below. Both triads follow the same pattern.

IF-KH-OQ

KH-MJ-QS
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c28817482dab245ca34a9ed2c7d15bec309f9c5ed7d11cb8daa13bef502bdd09.png] 

The logic followed here is:

 
• **First to Second Cluster:** Both letters in the first cluster shift **+2** positions forward in the English alphabetical order.
 
• **Second to Third Cluster:** The first letter shifts **+4** positions forward, and the second letter shifts **+9** positions forward in the English alphabetical order.

**IF : KH : OQ**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c62e05fe2880168e733d7f174ee9b3caa08dd0deeec84e5c95ee555f393c2bd2.png] 

**KH : MJ : QS**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e2a3d34e0fd139c1d163e581ced10073e47f7483635ac05b522cf3b82c081375.png] 

Now, let's apply this combined logic to the given options to find the triad that follows the same pattern:

**Option 1: MJ-OL-SU**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2e569fc2b9dfad00e701834c4daa019cdb4bb073ce451854af4e12fd07bdb7a5.png] 

This option **follows the pattern**.

**Option 2: NJ-OL-SV**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f465bca3310861648819e17b3c7851b47d817c63099cf178562c59b8d73fc751.png] 

This option does NOT follow the pattern.

**Option 3: NJ-OK-SV**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b5d62e1d8b0cb39aa3e2a4fdbfea14af197cf4186a0cd1b65e803f3f0d677299.png] 

This option does NOT follow the pattern.

**Option 4: MJ-OL-SV**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c6f64574aab3c6f85951bc71fe18915de9094139283848b771459066d507b70e.png] 

This option does NOT follow the pattern. 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
